| # Object 0x1015 inhibit time EMCY {#object-0x1015-inhibit-time-emcy-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Inhibit Time used for emergency message (emergency producer). The time has to be a multiple of 100 µs.

 

  Index           0x1014
  --------------- -------------------
  Name            Inhibit Time EMCY
  Object          VAR
  Data Type       UNSIGNED 16
  Category        Optional
  Access          RW
  PDO Mapping     No
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 16
  Default Value   0x01
